Limitation files a friction entry (kind other) about what got in the way of
dreaming: a verb that was missing, an item that couldn't be read. If the
summary is close to an open or accepted entry's, it files nothing and
names that entry. Only a dream's own agent runs it.

Usage:
  agent dream limitation "summary" [flags]

Examples:
  agent dream limitation "no way to read a subagent's transcript from the digest"

Flags:
      --detail string   More detail
  -h, --help            help for limitation

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)
